paragraph: The single-family market is Saddle Brook, with 39 closings over six months at a median of $655,000 against a median list of $625,000. Roughly 72 percent sold above asking and the median time to contract was 16 days, so buyers should expect competition on the good ones and sellers have been dictating terms. The typical sale is a three-bedroom with two full baths, mostly colonials, capes, and ranches, which is what keeps this town accessible relative to neighbors. Prices ran from $510,000 to $1,258,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. On the monthly series, the early-spring months are too thin to read, but May through July held between $631,000 and $660,000 while volume climbed to 15 closings in July. That is the seasonal arc working normally, with prices flat and the summer closing peak arriving on schedule. If Saddle Brook follows the usual pattern, expect volume to taper modestly through fall before deep winter thins it out. Condo and townhouse activity was three sales, too little to generalize from.
